english: The first of these three is a position of a number of followers of the Mind Only school. The second is described by Master Avalokita Vrata as belonging to members of the Detailist school: “It is a group within the Detailists different from the Kashmiris.” The third also belongs to a particular group within the Detailist school. As for the fourth, the case is not exactly clear; but since it accords with the ninth chapter of the autocommentary to the Treasure House of Higher Knowledge, it would seem to be a belief of the Sutrists, in addition to the Kashmiri section within the Detailists.
